WebVeda is the smartest subscription for the most ambitious Indians.
India Genius Challenge is a nationwide search for the brightest young minds of India.
In this video, I explore the “shame economy”; how the fear of “log kya kahenge” pushes us to overspend on dinners, trips, phones, weddings and lifestyles we cannot truly afford. Using data, I explain how social pressure, easy loans, EMIs and credit cards are quietly trapping an entire generation in debt.
